relevant_files.role: LanguageInfo struct definition and get_language_info registry
Template for ELEMENT_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY patterns
Complex inheritance extraction and test patterns

conventions.commits: Conventional Commits format with types (feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore); all commits must be GPG-signed with --signoff flag; DCO certification required
conventions.testing: Unit tests in #[cfg(test)] modules within each language file; tests cover element_query, inheritance extraction, defuse_query, function name extraction, and receiver type detection; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo deny check advisories licenses; workspace lints enforce undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (with test exemptions)
conventions.error_handling: tree-sitter::Query::new() and parser.parse() wrapped in .expect() in tests; production code uses Option/Result with thiserror; no unwrap() in production paths

patterns: Each language module defines ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants as &str
Language registration in get_language_info() match arm includes tree-sitter crate language, all query constants, and optional handler functions
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) take &Node and &str source, return Option or Vec
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) with tagged captures like @write.local, @read.usage
Extension map in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; language_for_extension() performs case-insensitive lookup
Test coverage includes query validation, node traversal via stack-based DFS, and SemanticExtractor integration tests for def-use sites
constraints: All languages are unconditionally compiled; no feature gates for individual languages
LanguageInfo struct fields are fixed; new language must provide all required fields or None for optional ones
tree-sitter grammar node kinds and field names must match exactly; queries fail silently if node kinds do not exist
Inheritance extraction must walk the AST using parent() and child_by_field_name() to locate base class and interface nodes
DEFUSE_QUERY must capture both write sites (declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) for semantic analysis
test_coverage: Existing language modules include unit tests for: (1) element_query validation via tree-sitter::Query and cursor matches, (2) extract_function_name with method/function declarations, (3) find_receiver_type for enclosing class/interface/enum, (4) find_method_for_receiver for method-in-class context, (5) extract_inheritance for superclass and interface lists, (6) defuse_query write sites (local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression), (7) defuse_query read sites (identifier usage). CSS has minimal tests (3 tests). Java has 6 tests. Kotlin has 30+ tests. Python has 12+ tests. Test patterns use parse_<lang>() helper, stack-based node traversal, tree_sitter::Query compilation, and SemanticExtractor integration.

library_findings.version: not yet in workspace (recommend 0.25.0 or latest)
library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration nodes; class_declaration has fields: name (required), body (required declaration_list), attributes (optional attribute_list); inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) child nodes, not field names
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes rather than fields; method_declaration and function_definition are distinct node kinds; interface_declaration and trait_declaration are separate from class_declaration; enum_declaration has enum_declaration_list body instead of declaration_list

library_findings.relevant_api: Parser::set_language(), Parser::parse(), Query::new(), QueryCursor::matches(), Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::parent(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Core parsing and query API; all language modules use identical pattern for parsing and querying

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to workspace dependencies and Cargo.toml; create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), CALL_QUERY, and IMPORT_QUERY; register in get_language_info() match with None for optional handlers; add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs; add 'php' to supported_languages() list; include 3-5 unit tests for element_query and import_query
pros: Minimal code changes (one new file, three edits to existing files)
Matches CSS pattern which is already in codebase
cons: Limited semantic capability compared to Java/Kotlin/Python

approaches.name: Full PHP support with inheritance and def-use (recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to workspace dependencies and Cargo.toml; create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler; register in get_language_info() match with all handlers; add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs; add 'php' to supported_languages() list; include 9+ unit tests covering element_query, inheritance extraction, defuse_query write/read sites, and function name extraction
pros: Enables semantic analysis (def-use tracking, inheritance chains)
Comprehensive test coverage (9+ tests across all dimensions)
Supports all PHP declaration kinds (class, interface, trait, enum, function, method)
Handles PHP-specific inheritance via base_clause and class_interface_clause
cons: More code to write and maintain
Requires understanding PHP grammar's base_clause/class_interface_clause structure

approaches.name: Phased approach: minimal first, handlers in follow-up PR
approaches.description: Phase 1 (this PR): Add tree-sitter-php dependency, create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY only; register in get_language_info() with None for all optional fields; add extension and language name. Phase 2 (follow-up PR): Add DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance handler with full test suite
cons: Requires two PRs instead of one
Maintenance burden of tracking two related PRs

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with inheritance and def-use). This approach delivers complete feature parity with existing language integrations (Java, Kotlin, Python) and aligns with the project's architecture. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because semantic analysis (def-use tracking) is a core capability of aptu-coder; without it, PHP support would be incomplete and inconsistent with other languages. The extract_inheritance handler is necessary to support class hierarchy analysis, which is critical for code understanding and refactoring tasks. The medium complexity is justified by the comprehensive capability it enables. Implementation should follow the Kotlin pattern for inheritance extraction (walking child nodes for base_clause and class_interface_clause) and the Java pattern for DEFUSE_QUERY (capturing local declarations, assignments, and identifier reads).

inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node in tree-sitter-php grammar: (1) iterate child nodes via node.child(i) for i in 0..node.child_count(); (2) identify base_clause child node (field name does not exist; it is a named child) which represents 'extends' clause; (3) extract the type name from base_clause's first named child (typically a name or qualified_name node); (4) identify class_interface_clause child node which represents 'implements' clause; (5) iterate named children of class_interface_clause to extract each interface name (each child is a name or qualified_name node). Source: tree-sitter-php grammar rule at https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js shows class_declaration uses optional($.base_clause) and optional($.class_interface_clause) as child nodes, not field names.
